description: Renovate is the single owner of dependency updates for this repo; keep repository-level (UI) Dependabot disabled.

Covers: pnpm dependencies (package.json + pnpm-lock.yaml — this repo uses pnpm, there is no package-lock.json), Go modules under apps/backend, Gradle dependencies, GitHub Actions pins, and Docker base images (nginx, postgres, distroless, golang, actions-runner).
The packageManager field (pnpm) is updated by the npm manager; Nx and Angular packages are grouped via the monorepo presets that config:recommended pulls in.

minimumReleaseAge is set to exceed pnpm's built-in minimumReleaseAge default (1440 minutes / 1 day, not overridden anywhere in this repo) so Renovate never proposes a bump pnpm's own install-time supply-chain check would then reject with ERR_PNPM_MINIMUM_RELEASE_AGE_VIOLATION.
The @jdw/* libraries are private workspace packages, versioned in-repo by nx release and never published to any registry.
libs/frontend/shared/ui declares @jdw/frontend-shared-util as a pinned peerDependency, so Renovate resolves it against npm, fails, and reports a repository problem on the dependency dashboard.

vitest majors are held at 4 because Angular's own unit-test builder cannot run 5: @angular/build transforms specs before vitest sees them, and vitest 5's hoisting validator then rejects a top-level vi.mock in libs/frontend/container/data-access as 'defined outside the module's top level scope' — reproduced with the call as the literal first statement in the file, reported at 1:1, so no source-level fix exists.

@angular/build 22.2.0 widened its vitest peer range to include 5 but changed nothing: the same spec fails identically, so the peer range is advisory, not a signal that the combination works. The vitest-native tool projects pass on 5, so Nx is not the blocker.

Minors and patches inside 4.x stay enabled. Re-enable majors once an @angular/build release fixes its transform's interaction with the vitest:mocks plugin — verify by running the Angular unit-test target on vitest 5 before removing this rule.

@material/material-color-utilities is pinned exact at 0.3.0 (not a caret range) in package.json and libs/frontend/shared/util/package.json — see the comment above the import in libs/frontend/shared/util/src/lib/on-color.util.ts.

0.4.0 ships nine scheme/*.js files (scheme_content, scheme_expressive, scheme_fidelity, scheme_fruit_salad, scheme_monochrome, scheme_neutral, scheme_rainbow, scheme_tonal_spot, scheme_vibrant) whose import of '../dynamiccolor/dynamic_scheme' is missing the .js extension. The package's own exports map only publishes the '.' barrel, so every consumer loads that broken chain through it.

Node's strict ESM resolver (used by pnpm's isolated node_modules linking and by Vitest/Vite) cannot fall back to extension-probing for that specifier, so importing anything from the package barrel throws Cannot find module '.../dynamiccolor/dynamic_scheme' at test time — reproduced by unpacking the published 0.4.0 tarball directly; 0.3.0 has no such imports.

Disabled rather than pinned-only because Renovate proposes replacing an exact pin same as a range; re-enable once a release newer than 0.4.0 ships with the extensions fixed upstream — verify a fresh tarball's scheme/*.js imports before removing this rule.
